normalized.description: The Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) is responsible for the site characterization of Dutch offshore wind energy projects. These works consist of the execution of three metocean campaigns at three offshore wind energy search areas, which will be further specified. The data for each site are obtained by means of two individual floating LiDAR systems and one spare to measure wind, wave and current properties. Preferably the systems will be in the commercial stage (3) of the OWA Roadmap for commercial acceptance of floating LiDAR technologies. The tender is divided into three (3) lots; one lot for every metocean campaign. Companies can submit an offer for one or multiple lot(s). The preferred starting date for Lot 1 is Q4 2022, and the preferred starting date for Lot 2 and Lot 3 is Q1 2023.
